steps.message: Do I have any events October 23 2023 in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell "date; getprop persist.sys.timezone; pm list packages | grep -i -E 'simple|calendar|fossify'"
